name: Consensus is computed on probabilities, not by averaging decimal odds
description: A common naive mistake is averaging the decimal odds across books and inverting that, or averaging 1/decimal without de-vigging. Both produce a distribution that does not sum to 1.0 and disagrees with the mean of de-vigged probabilities. This test detects the decimal-averaging trap.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /api/matches and read the first match id from the response
Navigate to /match-odds/<first-id>.json using the captured id
Compute the mean of the books' decimal.home values and invert it (1 / mean-decimal), then read the stored consensus.home

Verify the stored consensus.home matches the mean of the books' de-vigged home probabilities and does NOT equal the inverse of the averaged decimal odds. If consensus.home is closest to 1/(mean decimal.home) instead, the build used the decimal-averaging trap and fails.
